title: 2001 AMC 12 Problem 10
statement: The plane is tiled by congruent squares and congruent pentagons as indicated. The percent of the plane that is enclosed by the pentagons is closest to

solutions.text:
The pattern repeats over a \(3 \times 3\) block of nine unit squares. Four of these nine squares are not covered by pentagons; the rest of the area belongs to the pentagons.

So the pentagons enclose \[ 1 - \dfrac{4}{9} = \dfrac{5}{9} = 55.5\overline{5}\%, \] which is closest to \(56.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
